## 3. Condition + treatment shelf reality (before)

- `/conditions/` top-50 by traffic = **neck-fracture (~2/3 of shelf traffic), back-fracture,
  Dupuytren's, ankle-sprain.** The six priority spine canons contribute ~nothing. (Confirms
  the audit: KEEP/protect neck-fracture; the rescue targets start from zero.)
- `/treatment/` top-40 = TKA, finger-amputation, PT-branded, mass-removal, **caudal-esi**,
  laminectomy long-tail ("laminectomy incision" #3, "laminectomy scar" #5), kyphoplasty
  ("kyphoplasty vertebroplasty" #10, 2,900/mo). Endoscopic/microdiscectomy: no visibility —
  the stranded-differentiator finding stands. OptiLIF: no page, no rankings (T7 builds it).

## 5. Re-measure protocol (the "after")

Re-run the identical pulls at **+2 weeks (~Aug 5)** and **+4 weeks (~Aug 19, pre-Gate-1)**:
1. `domain_rank` — same columns (incl. featured-snippet / PAA / AI-Overview counts).
2. `resource_organic_unique` top 50 — did any spine canon enter the page table?
3. `resource_organic` on `/conditions/`, `/treatment/`, `/providers/` subfolders + the hub URL.
4. `phrase_these` on the §4 keyword set (volumes move slowly; our positions are the signal).

**Success signals per task:** T1/T4 = hub + canons appear at ANY position (0→top-100 is the
first win) · T3 = caudal holds #4–5 (no regression) · T5 = first non-branded provider
keyword appears · T2 = MRI page keyword count grows past 18 · T7 = optilif position #1–3
within weeks of publish (KD 1) · sitewide = AI-Overview keyword count rises from 2,276.
**GSC layer (human):** Randall's before-export must be dated BEFORE his first edit —
impressions/clicks/CTR/position per target URL + the brand-filtered non-branded baseline.
Semrush measures rank presence; GSC measures the funnel. Both, always.
